interface.name: denial_text_input_panel_manager_v1

description.summary: feedback for a text-input-v3 input panel

interface.description: Adds host dismissal feedback missing from text-input-v3. Creating a feedback object neither activates text input nor shows a keyboard. One feedback object is allowed per text input. The associated text input must belong to this client. Destroying it makes feedback inert.

interface.name: denial_text_input_panel_v1

description.summary: host panel dismissal for one text input

interface.description: Only an explicit user dismissal generates this event. Client disable, focus loss, compositor startup and automatic panel hiding do not. This does not request focus loss, text submission or application navigation. Other compositors may omit the extension; clients must remain usable.

event.name: dismissed
event.description: Serial is the associated text-input-v3 commit count at dismissal. Ignore an event whose serial no longer identifies the current editor state. This event is immediate, not part of a text-input done batch. Repeated dismissal without renewed editor engagement is ignored.
